G_definition: decoded final lossless RGB PNG at original canvas dimensions, expressed in float64 RGB code values /255
N_definition: exact hash-bound slot conditioning normal decoded with the same Pillow RGB conversion as generation, expressed in float64 RGB code values /255; do not JPEG-reencode it
not_used: source defect image, original training crop, VAE reconstruction baseline, detector features, labels as generated geometry

alignment_checks.reason: same frozen fixed_crop origin and inverse translation; final G and N share full canvas
512 crop, unit geometry scale; pipeline same-size preprocessing resize; no G-only spatial resize
full-canvas integer pixel centers (i+0.5,j+0.5), shared top-left origin; use recorded crop translation, not recentering
RGB encoded-code-value comparison, no ICC transform, EXIF transpose, grayscale, or linear-light conversion introduced in measurement. This is not radiometric error.
G rounded/clipped uint8 and saved as RGB PNG. N is decoded source RGB in same code-value scale; different file encodings do not invalidate decoded coordinates.

domains.P: valid paste rectangle; padding outside original image NEVER contributes
domains.B: all unit pixels inside the recorded raster bbox, translated to full coordinates
domains.bbox_convention: floor/ceil rectangular raster is an evaluation ROI, not segmentation; requested center/width/height remain continuous original_bbox_xyxy

zero_energy_rule: If E_total=0, ratios/centroids/covariance requiring this denominator are null with UNDEFINED_ZERO_EDIT_ENERGY, not zero/good accuracy. Bbox-conditional moments similarly require E_B>0. Report counts and retain slots.
future_binding_requirements: verify actual G file SHA and recorded RGB hash, normal SHA, canvas size/mode and same slot geometry
pin complete decoder/preprocessing source versions including image_processor and VAE dependencies
no image warp or convenience resize; mismatch => RESIDUAL_MEASUREMENT_NOT_VALID, stop this metric route without redefining or dropping slots
limitations: R measures all edits: intended defect, background resynthesis, reconstruction/quantization changes and artifacts are inseparable without independent truth
the current code permits outside-bbox updates; residual energy is not defect probability
structural validity does NOT prove useful control failure or class/visibility accuracy
